running_balance.description: Chronological balance across this register scope; null if the intermediate amount exceeds exact JSON monetary range.

deleted.description: Only mutation responses for already published tombstones; fields may merge without restoring visibility.

sort_order.description: Stable display ordering on fresh reads and new mutation outcomes. Historical exact receipt replays may omit it.

retained_payee_id.description: Retained identity for history, including removed payees. payee_id is null after removal; imported_payee never changes during payee management.

children.description: Active child allocations in stable split order. Parent totals count once in registers; reports use children instead of the parent.

transfer_account_id.description: Account of the linked counterpart, when linked.

running_balance_error.description: Present only when an intermediate running balance cannot be represented as an exact safe JSON integer; page and final totals remain available.

order_key.description: Optional opaque display ordering key for recovered legacy positions. Sort lexically within transaction date, falling back to signed native sort_order encoded as a 16-digit lowercase hexadecimal value with sign bit flipped. Private integer ranks and original field HLCs remain unchanged.
